# Project: Ray Tracer TDD implementation

- Description: This is an implementation of a simple ray tracer in Rust using TDD. For learning purposes.

## General Instructions

- As this is a project for learning, the code should be clean and understandable first
- Document all classes and method definitions, but keep in-method comments to a mininum.
- Use helper methods as necessary.

## Repo instructions

- Use nalgebra primitives for basic linear algebra tasks such as vector and matrix multipication. For operations that are used in computer graphics (for example translations, rotations and intersections), implement the operations in this code, even if more performant alternatives exist in nalgebra - remember, this repo is for learning purposes
- Remember to escape parenthesis for Gherkin matchers
